novel_features.name: Served history
novel_features.description: See every lunch you were actually served, with date, vendor, items and price.
novel_features.rationale: Built from synced order history; the app only shows a flat recent list.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs a longitudinal record of what a person ate rather than today's menu.

novel_features.name: Venue rotation
novel_features.description: Rank vendors by how often and how recently you ordered from them.
novel_features.rationale: Requires aggregating the full synced order history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to spot vendor fatigue or under-used favorites before choosing lunch.

novel_features.name: Spend trends
novel_features.description: Spend per month or week, split into subsidy-covered and out-of-pocket.
novel_features.rationale: Requires time-bucketing synced orders and their subsidy lines.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for budget or subsidy-utilization reporting.

novel_features.name: Week-ahead digest
novel_features.description: One-line-per-day digest of upcoming events and restaurants at your building.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates several days of event searches into one view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a quick morning check of what is being served this week.

novel_features.name: Subsidy status
novel_features.description: Remaining dollars of today's subsidy and when it is valid.
novel_features.rationale: Parses the remaining balance out of the subsidy QR payload the app never shows as a number.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before ordering to know how much of the meal is covered.

novel_features.name: Menu search
novel_features.description: Search menu items across all of today's events.
novel_features.rationale: Fans out over every event's menu page and filters locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for dietary or craving lookups without opening each vendor page.

narrative.headline: Your Fooda office lunch history, subsidy and this week's popups in a terminal, with vendor and spend analytics the app does not offer.
narrative.value_prop: Fooda has no public API. This CLI reads the logged-in web app with your Chrome session, syncs your order history locally, and answers questions like what you ate, where you keep ordering, and how much subsidy you have left today.
narrative.auth_narrative: Fooda sits behind Cloudflare and has no API key. Log in to app.fooda.com in Chrome, then run `auth login --chrome` to import your session cookies, or use `auth login --cookies-file <file>` to import cookies from a JSON file. The CLI never logs in itself.

quickstart.comment: Check the install without needing a session
See how much of today's subsidy is left
See what is being served this week
Pull your order history into the local store
See which vendors you order from most

troubleshoots.symptom: Please log in to app.fooda.com in Chrome
troubleshoots.fix: Log in at https://app.fooda.com in Chrome, then run fooda-pp-cli auth login --chrome
Cloudflare challenges the profile page for non-browser clients; account and building ids still come from the home page

narrative.when_to_use: Use for questions about a person's Fooda office lunches: what is being served, what they ordered, vendor repeat patterns, and subsidy balance.
anti_triggers: Placing or canceling orders (order place, order cancel) are dry-run-only stubs
whoami is limited by Cloudflare challenges (account and building IDs are extracted from the home page)
Do not use it for Fooda Catering orders or billing
